summary: Fort Technology Inc, a Toronto-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing securities purchase agreements dated November 11, 2026 with institutional accredited investors for up to $20,000,000 in unsecured convertible promissory notes plus warrants, sold at a 10% original issue discount (90% of principal). Initial closing covers $1,100,000 principal per investor ($990,000 purchase price), with quarterly draws at company discretion; 8% coupon (14% on default), 28-month maturity, ten equal monthly installments from month 18, conversion at the lower of fixed price or a floating discount. Each investor receives a $500,000 commitment fee in shares; resale registration on Form F-1/F-3 within 30 trading days. Watch dilution, conversion-price resets and share overhang as the risk-arb angle.
